cohortRule: Positive learners, teachers, institutions, same-year population and a nonempty reported-use title vector after minimum document frequency 2. Same cohort for all candidates.
selectionRule: Eligible: every cluster has at least max(3, ceil(5% of cohort)) areas; largest cluster <=75%. Maximize 0.5 × silhouette + 0.5 × mean adjusted Rand index across five deterministic 80% subsamples; ties prefer silhouette, then smaller k.
limitations: Internal separation and perturbation stability are not external validity. Comparing feature spaces by silhouette has limitations. Missing profiles and curation differences affect results. Population and textbook profile years describe different sources. Binary term frequency is independent of duplicated stage records.
